Q: if then if .. else if Tableau to Power BI A: 
Result = 
-- Use variables to keep it fast and readable
VAR System = 'Table'[SYSTEM]
VAR Opt = 'Table'[Option]
VAR Act = 'Table'[Activity]
VAR Ind = 'Table'[Add Indicator]
VAR Nm = 'Table'[Name]

RETURN
SWITCH( TRUE(),
    System = "ABC", [Result Flag],
    
    -- System XYZ Logic (Flattened)
    System = "XYZ" && Opt = "HIGH" && Act = "Add" && Ind = "Yes", "GA",
    System = "XYZ" && Opt = "HIGH" && Act = "Add" && Nm IN {"Add 1", "Add 2"}, "Not Eligible",
    System = "XYZ" && Opt = "Low", "2019",
    System = "XYZ", "Not Eligible",
    
    -- Final Else
    [Result Flag]
)

Q: Android Studio 's xml file @id not work A:

It can be defined in ids.xml or any custom file like constants.xml inside your res\values folder.

Examples:

<resources>
<item type="id" name="keyboard" />

and can be accessed in the code as following:

R.id.keyboard

Q: Enabling zoom on scroll view A:

Try using FrameLayout and have a look at this official document: Zooming a View.

Q: Enabling URL Rewriting with ASP.NET using web.config A:

If you are using a newer version of IIS or using Windows Azure, you don't need the <ConfigSection>. It is built-in in the new IIS. Simply go ahead and use <rewrite> tag directly under <system.webServer> in your web.config.
